name: singlet_annotation_cross_dataset_label_reconciliation
title: Cross-dataset label reconciliation
description: Reconciles author cell-type labels from two or more studies into pairwise relations (equivalent, one-to-many, many-to-one, novel) and one harmonised label and parent per cell. The default cellhint method needs no training and reports the thresholds it used; popv adds Cell Ontology votes given an OBO file, and metaneighbor only scores replicability. Requires a study column and a label column; writes uns/harmonisation/relations and obs/harmonised_label. Do not use it to label an unlabelled dataset; use reference label transfer for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

dataset_key.description: obs column giving the study of each cell; needs at least two distinct values.

label_key.description: obs column holding each cell's author label; missing labels stay unassigned.

method.description: Reconciliation method; cellhint gives relation types with thresholds.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for the popv classifiers; the cellhint tree option uses cellhint.random_state. Default cellhint is deterministic.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

cellhint.description: Options for method cellhint; ignored by the other methods.

use_rep.description: Representation for distances: auto uses X_pca when present, otherwise X.

distance_metric.description: Cell-to-type distance; null uses correlation on X and euclidean on embeddings.

use_pct.description: Use predictive clustering trees instead of direct distances.

reorder_dataset.description: Order studies by similarity before alignment; ignored when dataset_order is set.

dataset_order.description: Explicit study order; must list every study value.

minimum_unique_percents.description: Grid for the one-to-one threshold; the setting with fewest alignments is kept.

minimum_divide_percents.description: Grid for one-to-many and many-to-one thresholds.

maximum_novel_percent.description: Fraction below which a type is called novel.

random_state.description: Seed for the predictive clustering tree when use_pct is true.

p_thres.description: F-test p-value threshold for pruning predictive clustering trees.

metaneighbor.description: Options for method metaneighbor; ignored by the other methods.

fast_version.description: Use the alternative AUROC computation path of the reference implementation.

node_degree_normalization.description: Divide neighbour votes by node degree.

popv.description: Options for method popv; ignored by the other methods.

methods.description: Classifier names; null uses all algorithms of the reference implementation.

cl_obo_file.description: Cell Ontology OBO file for ontology votes; null skips the ontology step.

knn_scvi_n_neighbors.description: Neighbours in the k-NN classifier on the scVI latent space.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/harmonisation/relations. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, dataset_order, relation counts by type, thresholds, unassigned_cells. Never raw tables.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
